resources.string: This device could not be reached. On it, open Channel + → More → Local sync and turn Sync mode on. Both devices must be on the same Wi-Fi.
Colour of the Channel + icon and logo
You chose a new icon and logo. They take effect after Channel + restarts.
What Channel + shows when it starts: Home, the channel you watched last, your favourites, or a channel you pick.
Looks on GitHub for a newer Channel + now and offers to install it. Your playlists, favourites and settings stay as they are.
Stage draws Channel +’s own soft colours. Picture shows a picture of yours behind every screen. Plain is a flat dark fill.
The Channel + logo in the menu, About and setup shows its play triangle in your accent colour. The icon on the home screen keeps its own colours.
This address is for the Channel + app on your other device. Open Local sync there and pick this device from the list.
